description: OpenFold-based inference pipeline for AlphaFold-Multimer, with TensorRT and cuEq accelerations (selected by sequence length for throughput)
MSA/search backend used for paired MSA generation (release 18)
AlphaFold-Multimer model weights used for complex inference (v2.3.0)
Interface scoring / QA metrics (ipSAE, pDockQ, pDockQ2, LIS)

details: Filtered paired MSA generation using MMseqs2-GPU via OpenFold

Post-processing interface QA metrics computed with ipSAE
